title: TOWARDS UNDERSTANDING SUBLIMINAL LEARNING: WHEN AND HOW HIDDEN BIASES TRANSFER
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mechanistic analysis of how hidden biases (specifically animal preferences) transfer during model distillation.
